plugin.name: File Redaction
plugin.description: Inspect sensitive information, generate desensitized copies, and restore with recovery packages.
view.main.name: File Redaction
tool.desensitize_preview.desc: Preview which sensitive items in a project file would be redacted (read-only, creates no file).
tool.desensitize_redact.desc: Redact sensitive information in a project file and save it as a NEW redacted copy; the original is never overwritten.
